result.summary: TASK-013 executed: CONV-015 closed by giving the destructive reset suite its own database, and CONV-016 closed by removing a stray control character that had made a coverage assertion partly inert and the Lint gate red.
unexpectedFindings: CONV-016. apps/web/tests/hr/demo-reset-coverage.spec.ts carried a literal 0x08 byte where a word boundary was intended, so explicitlyDeleted() matched nothing and the explicit-deletion arm of the coverage assertion had never evaluated. Restored, it finds 47 models. It is also an eslint ERROR, so npm run lint exited 1 and CI gate 2 would have failed on the first push. Four green full-suite runs did not reveal it, because vitest does not lint.

VER-0008 records npm run lint as exitCode 0 with zero errors. That was not true when it was written; the control character was introduced in the commit TASK-012 produced. The record is left in place and corrected in convergence.md. The likely cause is reading an exit code from a pipeline ending in tail, which reports tail status rather than the command under test.

EVC-023. npm run format:check reports 908 files on this Windows checkout, entirely because core.autocrlf is true with no .gitattributes while Prettier defaults endOfLine to lf. Isolated on one file: identical bytes pass with LF and fail with CRLF. Deliberately not repaired - npm run format would rewrite 908 files for no behavioural reason.

The two mitigations removed from the persona suite were not merely insufficient, they were harmful. Both would have absorbed a genuine 401 regression in the file that asserts tenant isolation and platform-control-plane denial, which is the last place a self-healing test should exist.
scopeDeviations: This session was opened AFTER the work was done rather than before it, which docs/sdd/AGENT_SESSION_STANDARD.md requires the other way round. The record is honest about it: initialChangedPaths lists the already-modified files and scope-check attributes 8 paths as pre-existing rather than to this session. Nothing is backdated.

apps/web/playwright.config.ts was edited to read APP_URL once instead of twice. It is inside TASK-013 allowed scope, but the motivation was not a listed finding: baseURL tested it with ?? while the webServer block tested truthiness, so APP_URL= empty started a server on 3000 and pointed every request at the empty string. Small, and adjacent to CONV-009 which this specification owns.
docs/EVIDENCE_CONFLICTS.md and specs/SPEC-0009-.../ were changed in the same working tree by other work in this session and are not attributed to this task.
newUnknowns: Whether the isolated database costs enough time in CI to matter. Locally it adds a create-and-migrate to one file and the run is unchanged at about 150 seconds, but CI has never executed this path - the branch has never been pushed.

Whether the other tests that share the demo fixture have the same latent coupling and simply have not been observed. Only the reset suite writes, so nothing else should; that is reasoning, not evidence.
Whether any other verification record in this specification cites an exit code read through a pipe. VER-0008 did; the rest were not re-checked.
